# Azure Arc – Connected Machine Agent Version Compliance
**What this workbook answers:** ① Are my Azure Arc agents on a **likely supported version (estimate)**? ② Is **automatic agent upgrade** enabled and working? ③ **What must be fixed**, and on which servers?

**How to use it:** choose subscriptions and filters above → **1 Overview** for the big picture and the servers that need action (optional **2 Distribution** charts: *Show distribution charts*) → **3 Advisor** for blockers (expired / disconnected) → **4 Server inventory** for the server list → **5 Automatic upgrade** and **6 Manual upgrade paths** to fix → **7 Policy** to enforce at scale → **8 Extensions** as an extra check. Every table can be filtered and exported to Excel. No version list is maintained in this workbook – the reference is read live from Azure.

# Azure Arc – Conformidade de versão do Connected Machine Agent
**O que este workbook responde:** ① Meus agents Azure Arc estão numa **versão provavelmente suportada (estimativa)**? ② O **upgrade automático do agent** está habilitado e funcionando? ③ **O que precisa ser corrigido** e em quais servidores?

**Como usar:** escolha assinaturas e filtros acima → **1 Visão geral** para o panorama e os servidores que precisam de ação (gráficos opcionais de **2 Distribuição**: *Mostrar gráficos de distribuição*) → **3 Advisor** para bloqueios (expirados / desconectados) → **4 Inventário** para a lista de servidores → **5 Upgrade automático** e **6 Caminhos de upgrade manual** para corrigir → **7 Policy** para aplicar em escala → **8 Extensões** como verificação extra. Todas as tabelas podem ser filtradas e exportadas para Excel. Nenhuma lista de versões é mantida no workbook – a referência é lida do Azure em tempo real.

parameters.name: OsFilter
parameters.label: OS
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| summarize by value = tolower(tostring(properties.osType))
| where isnotempty(value)
| order by value asc

parameters.name: StatusFilter
parameters.label: Connection Status
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| summarize by value = tostring(properties.status)
| order by value asc

parameters.name: ShowCharts
parameters.label: Show distribution charts / Mostrar gráficos de distribuição

parameters.name: ApiVersion
parameters.label: HybridCompute API version
parameters.description: api-version used to read the official agent catalog (Agent Version - List).

parameters.name: SupportWindow
parameters.label: Support estimate window (releases)
parameters.description: Heuristic release-count window, not the official date-based support determination. Verify each version against the release notes (last 12 months).

parameters.name: AutoUpgradeTolerance
parameters.label: Auto-upgrade tolerance (releases)
parameters.description: Heuristic, not a documented guarantee: Microsoft rolls automatic upgrades out in batches by region during off-peak hours and retries failed upgrades (Automatically upgrade the Azure Connected Machine agent). A server is 'On track' when it is at most this many releases behind latest.

parameters.name: IncludeFleetMax
parameters.label: Include highest installed version as "latest"
parameters.description: Default "No". When "Yes", the highest agent version found on your servers can also count as the latest version. Not an official source: one server running a newer or preview build would make every other server look behind. Use only if Azure returns no upgrade target and the catalog is empty or outdated.

parameters.name: LatestOverride
parameters.label: Latest override (optional)
parameters.description: Manual reference from the agent release notes (e.g. 1.69). Default 1.69 because the Hybrid Compute catalog API still returns 1.68 as 'latest'. Clear the field when the API catches up. / Referência manual das release notes. Padrão 1.69 porque a API do catálogo ainda retorna 1.68. Limpe o campo quando a API atualizar.

parameters.name: ExtApiVersion
parameters.label: Extension metadata API version
parameters.description: api-version for Extension Metadata V2 - List (versions published by Azure per region/publisher/type).

parameters.name: MinAutoUpgradeVersion
parameters.label: Min version for auto-upgrade
parameters.description: Docs (Automatically upgrade the Azure Connected Machine agent): automatic agent upgrade requires agent 1.67 or later (Windows: PowerShell execution policy RemoteSigned; Linux: cron service).

parameters.name: SecurityFloorVersion
parameters.label: Configured minimum agent version (security review)
parameters.description: Agents below this version are flagged regardless of the support window. Default 1.61: CVE-2026-26117 affects agents < 1.61 and CVE-2025-49692 affects agents < 1.49 (CVE records); CVE-2025-26627 and CVE-2025-55316 are listed as in Arc Posture Review. The two advisories checked describe the Windows agent; the floor is applied to all operating systems. Newer security fixes appear in the agent release notes (for example 1.63 CVE-2026-2673 on Linux and 1.65 CVE-2026-47632) - consider raising the floor. Leave empty to disable. At or above this floor is NOT a security guarantee.

parameters.name: AnyOsTarget
parameters.label: Auto-upgrade target (any OS)
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| extend dv = tostring(properties.agentUpgrade.desiredVersion), lv = tostring(properties.agentUpgrade.lastAttemptDesiredVersion)
| extend dr = iff(isempty(dv), int(null), toint(split(dv, '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split(dv, '.')[1])), lr = iff(isempty(lv), int(null), toint(split(lv, '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split(lv, '.')[1]))
| summarize t = max(max_of(coalesce(dr, -1), coalesce(lr, -1)))
| project v = iff(isnull(t) or t < 0, 'none', strcat(tostring(t / 1000), '.', tostring(t % 1000)))

parameters.name: LatestSummary
parameters.label: Latest summary
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| extend p = properties
| extend osType = tolower(tostring(p.osType)), agentVersion = tostring(p.agentVersion), status = tostring(p.status)
| extend agentRank = iff(isempty(agentVersion), int(null), toint(split(agentVersion, '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split(agentVersion, '.')[1]))
| extend autoUpgradeEnabled = tobool(p.agentUpgrade.enableAutomaticUpgrade), desiredVersion = tostring(p.agentUpgrade.desiredVersion), lastAttemptStatus = iff(isempty(tostring(p.agentUpgrade.lastAttemptStatus)), '', strcat(toupper(substring(tostring(p.agentUpgrade.lastAttemptStatus), 0, 1)), tolower(substring(tostring(p.agentUpgrade.lastAttemptStatus), 1)))), lastAttemptDesiredVersion = tostring(p.agentUpgrade.lastAttemptDesiredVersion), lastAttemptTimestamp = todatetime(p.agentUpgrade.lastAttemptTimestamp), lastAttemptMessage = tostring(p.agentUpgrade.lastAttemptMessage)
| extend lastStatusChange = todatetime(p.lastStatusChange), osSku = tostring(p.osSku), osName = tostring(p.osName), osVersion = tostring(p.osVersion), machineFqdn = tostring(p.machineFqdn), machineKind = tostring(kind), cloudProvider = tostring(p.detectedProperties.cloudprovider), proxyUrl = tostring(p.agentConfiguration.proxyUrl)
| project id = tolower(id), name, subscriptionId, resourceGroup, location, osType, agentVersion, agentRank, status, autoUpgradeEnabled, desiredVersion, lastAttemptStatus, lastAttemptDesiredVersion, lastAttemptTimestamp, lastAttemptMessage, lastStatusChange, osSku, osName, osVersion, machineFqdn, machineKind, cloudProvider, proxyUrl
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
    | extend osType = tolower(tostring(properties.osType)), av = tostring(properties.agentVersion), dv = tostring(properties.agentUpgrade.desiredVersion), lv = tostring(properties.agentUpgrade.lastAttemptDesiredVersion)
    | extend ar = iff(isempty(av), int(null), toint(split(av, '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split(av, '.')[1])), dr = iff(isempty(dv), int(null), toint(split(dv, '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split(dv, '.')[1])), lr = iff(isempty(lv), int(null), toint(split(lv, '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split(lv, '.')[1]))
    | summarize fleetMaxRank = max(ar), desiredMaxRank = max(dr), attemptMaxRank = max(lr) by osType
    | extend lst = iff(osType == 'linux', split(strcat('{ReleasedLinux}', ',', '{ReleasedLinux2}', ',', '{ReleasedLinux3}', ',', '{ReleasedLinux4}'), ','), split(strcat('{ReleasedWindows}', ',', '{ReleasedWindows2}', ',', '{ReleasedWindows3}', ',', '{ReleasedWindows4}'), ','))
    | mv-expand v = lst to typeof(string) limit 2000
    | extend vRank = iff(isempty(v), int(null), toint(split(v, '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split(v, '.')[1]))
    | summarize catalogMaxRank = max(vRank), catalogOldestRank = min(vRank), catalogSize = countif(isnotnull(vRank)), catalogSet = make_set(vRank) by osType, fleetMaxRank, desiredMaxRank, attemptMaxRank
    | extend catalogList = strcat(',', strcat_array(catalogSet, ','), ',')
    | project-away catalogSet
) on osType
| extend targetMaxRank = iff(isnull(desiredMaxRank) or (isnotnull(attemptMaxRank) and attemptMaxRank > desiredMaxRank), attemptMaxRank, desiredMaxRank)
| extend overrideRank = iff(isempty('{LatestOverride}'), int(null), toint(split('{LatestOverride}', '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split('{LatestOverride}', '.')[1]))
| extend c1 = coalesce(catalogMaxRank, -1), c2 = coalesce(targetMaxRank, -1), c3 = iff('{IncludeFleetMax}' == 'Yes', coalesce(fleetMaxRank, -1), -1), c4 = iff(isnull(targetMaxRank) and '{AnyOsTarget}' != 'none' and isnotempty('{AnyOsTarget}'), toint(split('{AnyOsTarget}', '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split('{AnyOsTarget}', '.')[1]), -1)
| extend autoLatest = max_of(c1, c2, c3, c4)
| extend latestRank = case(isnotnull(overrideRank), overrideRank, autoLatest >= 0, autoLatest, int(null))
| extend latestSource = case(isnotnull(overrideRank), 'Manual override', isnull(latestRank), 'Unavailable', latestRank == c2, 'Azure auto-upgrade target', latestRank == c4, 'Azure auto-upgrade target (other OS)', latestRank == c1, 'Catalog API', 'Fleet maximum')
| extend minAutoRank = toint(split('{MinAutoUpgradeVersion}', '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split('{MinAutoUpgradeVersion}', '.')[1])
| extend desiredRank = iff(isempty(desiredVersion), int(null), toint(split(desiredVersion, '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split(desiredVersion, '.')[1]))
| extend officialLatest = iff(isnull(latestRank), '-', strcat(tostring(latestRank / 1000), '.', tostring(latestRank % 1000)))
| extend agentMajorMinor = iff(isnull(agentRank), 'Unknown', strcat(tostring(agentRank / 1000), '.', tostring(agentRank % 1000)))
| extend inCatalog = isnotnull(agentRank) and catalogList contains strcat(',', tostring(agentRank), ',')
| extend catalogMatch = case(isnull(agentRank), 'No agent version reported', isnull(catalogSize) or catalogSize == 0, 'Catalog API returned nothing', inCatalog, 'Listed in catalog API', agentRank > catalogMaxRank, 'Newer than catalog API', agentRank < catalogOldestRank, 'Older than catalog API', 'Not listed (gap)')
| extend versionsBehind = iff(isnull(agentRank) or isnull(latestRank), int(null), iff(latestRank > agentRank, latestRank - agentRank, 0))
| extend supportStatus = case(isnull(agentRank) or isnull(latestRank), 'Unknown', agentRank >= latestRank, 'Latest', versionsBehind < toint('{SupportWindow}'), 'Supported', 'Out of support')
| extend autoUpgradeLabel = case(autoUpgradeEnabled == true, 'Enabled', autoUpgradeEnabled == false, 'Disabled', 'N/A')
| extend autoUpgradeEligible = isnotnull(agentRank) and agentRank >= minAutoRank
| extend upgradeHealth = case(isnull(agentRank), 'Unknown', autoUpgradeLabel == 'Enabled' and isnotnull(versionsBehind) and versionsBehind <= toint('{AutoUpgradeTolerance}'), 'On track', autoUpgradeLabel == 'Enabled' and lastAttemptStatus =~ 'Failed', 'Failing', autoUpgradeLabel == 'Enabled' and status != 'Connected', 'Blocked (not connected)', autoUpgradeLabel == 'Enabled', 'Lagging', autoUpgradeEligible, 'Disabled (eligible)', isnotnull(agentRank), 'Not eligible (manual upgrade)', 'Unknown')
| extend desiredVsOfficial = case(isnull(desiredRank), '-', isnull(latestRank), 'Latest unavailable', desiredRank >= latestRank, 'Targets latest', 'Targets older than latest')
| extend upgradeStatus = case(isnull(desiredRank), '-', agentRank >= desiredRank, 'Completed', status != 'Connected', 'Pending (disconnected)', 'Pending')
| extend daysInStatus = datetime_diff('day', now(), lastStatusChange)
| extend dataFreshness = iff(status == 'Connected', 'Live', 'Last reported (stale)')
| extend floorRank = iff(isempty('{SecurityFloorVersion}'), int(null), toint(split('{SecurityFloorVersion}', '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split('{SecurityFloorVersion}', '.')[1]))
| extend securityFloor = case(isnull(floorRank), 'Not evaluated', isnull(agentRank), 'Unknown', agentRank < floorRank, 'Below security floor', 'OK')
| where osType in ({OsFilter}) or 'All' in ({OsFilter})
| where status in ({StatusFilter}) or 'All' in ({StatusFilter})
| where supportStatus in ({SupportFilter}) or 'All' in ({SupportFilter})
| where autoUpgradeLabel in ({AutoUpgradeFilter}) or 'All' in ({AutoUpgradeFilter})
| summarize lr = max(latestRank) by osType, latestSource
| extend s = strcat(osType, ' ', iff(isnull(lr), '-', strcat(tostring(lr / 1000), '.', tostring(lr % 1000))), ' (', latestSource, ')')
| summarize v = strcat_array(make_list(s), ' · ')

> 📏 **Reference in use** · latest agent **{LatestSummary}**
> - **Supported** = fewer than **{SupportWindow}** releases behind latest (Microsoft supports agent versions released within the last year).
> - **On track** = auto-upgrade on, connected, last attempt not failed and ≤ **{AutoUpgradeTolerance}** release behind (heuristic – upgrades roll out in batches).
> - **Security floor** = agent ≥ **{SecurityFloorVersion}** (known elevation-of-privilege CVEs below it).

> 📏 **Referência em uso** · agent latest **{LatestSummary}**
> - **Suportado** = menos de **{SupportWindow}** releases atrás da latest (a Microsoft suporta versões do agent lançadas no último ano).
> - **Em dia** = upgrade automático ativo, conectado, sem falha na última tentativa e ≤ **{AutoUpgradeTolerance}** release atrás (heurística – os upgrades são liberados em lotes).
> - **Piso de segurança** = agent ≥ **{SecurityFloorVersion}** (CVEs conhecidos de elevação de privilégio abaixo dele).

⚠️ **Support status is an estimate** – confirm dates in the [agent release notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-arc/servers/agent-release-notes). Auxiliary tool, **not** an official Microsoft compliance report. *Latest* is the highest version Azure reports (auto-upgrade target and catalog) and can lag the newest release in the release notes – use *Latest override* if needed.

⚠️ **O status de suporte é uma estimativa** – confirme as datas nas [release notes do agent](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-arc/servers/agent-release-notes). Ferramenta auxiliar, **não** é relatório oficial de compliance da Microsoft. A *latest* é a maior versão que o Azure informa (alvo do upgrade automático e catálogo) e pode estar atrás da release mais nova das release notes – use o *Latest override* se necessário.

## ⚠️ ATTENTION – Latest version set MANUALLY: **{LatestOverride}**
The Azure catalog API (`osType/agentVersions/latest`) still returns **1.68**, but the [agent release notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-arc/servers/agent-release-notes) already list a newer release.
- **Effect:** servers on 1.68 appear as **behind** until the catalog catches up.
- **To use the API value only:** clear the *Latest override* parameter.

## ⚠️ ATENÇÃO – Versão latest definida MANUALMENTE: **{LatestOverride}**
A API de catálogo do Azure (`osType/agentVersions/latest`) ainda retorna **1.68**, mas as [release notes do agent](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-arc/servers/agent-release-notes) já listam uma versão mais nova.
- **Efeito:** servidores na 1.68 aparecem como **atrás** até o catálogo atualizar.
- **Para usar apenas o valor da API:** limpe o parâmetro *Latest override*.

##### 📖 Version status
| Status | Meaning → action |
|---|---|
| **Latest** | On latest version → none |
| **Supported** | Within the release-count estimate; confirm dates in official release notes → plan upgrade / enable auto-upgrade |
| **Out of support** | Outside the release-count estimate; confirm dates in official release notes → upgrade now |
| **Unknown** | No version or no reference → check connectivity / *Latest override* |
| **Disconnected** | No heartbeat (sent every 5 min) for 15–30 min; returns to Connected by itself → check network and the agent service |
| **Expired** | Disconnected for about 45 days; cannot be managed until disconnected and reconnected → re-onboard the server |
| **Last reported (stale)** | Server disconnected or expired, version is last reported → restore connectivity or re-onboard |
| **LatestSource** | Origin of *latest*: Azure auto-upgrade target, Catalog API, Fleet max or Override |
| **Below security floor** | Agent below the configured minimum (known CVEs); meeting it is not proof of security → upgrade now, even if *Supported* |

##### 🔄 Auto-upgrade status
| Status | Meaning → action |
|---|---|
| **On track** | Connected, last attempt not failed, within tolerance → monitor |
| **Lagging** | Enabled, behind tolerance → check last attempt |
| **Failing** | Last attempt failed → review message, PowerShell execution policy (RemoteSigned on Windows), cron service (Linux), proxy |
| **Blocked (not connected)** | Enabled but disconnected → restore connectivity |
| **Disabled (eligible)** | Supported but off → enable (Policy / CLI) |
| **Not eligible (manual upgrade)** | Agent below the minimum version (1.67 per Microsoft Learn) → upgrade manually |

##### 📖 Status de versão
| Status | Significado → ação |
|---|---|
| **Latest** | Na versão mais recente → nenhuma |
| **Supported** | Dentro da estimativa por número de releases; confirme as datas nas notas oficiais → planejar upgrade / habilitar auto-upgrade |
| **Out of support** | Fora da estimativa por número de releases; confirme as datas nas notas oficiais → atualizar agora |
| **Unknown** | Sem versão ou sem referência → verificar conectividade / *Latest override* |
| **Disconnected** | Sem heartbeat (enviado a cada 5 min) por 15–30 min; volta a Connected sozinho → verificar rede e o serviço do agente |
| **Expired** | Desconectado há cerca de 45 dias; não pode ser gerenciado até desconectar e reconectar → fazer o reonboard do servidor |
| **Last reported (stale)** | Servidor desconectado ou expirado, versão é a última reportada → restaurar conectividade ou fazer reonboard |
| **LatestSource** | Origem da *latest*: alvo do auto-upgrade do Azure, API de catálogo, máximo da frota ou override |
| **Below security floor** | Agent abaixo do mínimo configurado (CVEs conhecidos); atingí-lo não comprova segurança → atualizar agora, mesmo se *Supported* |

##### 🔄 Status do upgrade automático
| Status | Significado → ação |
|---|---|
| **On track** | Conectado, sem falha na última tentativa, dentro da tolerância → acompanhar |
| **Lagging** | Ativo, além da tolerância → ver última tentativa |
| **Failing** | Última tentativa falhou → ver mensagem, execution policy do PowerShell (RemoteSigned no Windows), serviço cron (Linux), proxy |
| **Blocked (not connected)** | Ativo, mas desconectado → restabelecer conectividade |
| **Disabled (eligible)** | Suportado, mas desligado → habilitar (Policy / CLI) |
| **Not eligible (manual upgrade)** | Agent abaixo da versão mínima (1.67 conforme o Microsoft Learn) → atualizar manualmente |

content.json:
> ℹ️ **How "latest" and status are computed (no hard-coded versions)**
> - **Latest (per OS)** = highest of: (1) the **auto-upgrade target set by Azure** on any machine (`agentUpgrade.desiredVersion` / `lastAttemptDesiredVersion`), (2) the **Hybrid Compute agent catalog API**, (3) optionally the fleet maximum, or (4) a manual override. Column *LatestSource* shows which one won.
> - The catalog API returns a **paged** list whose content varies between calls and, in tests, did not include the newest release – it is therefore cross-checked, not used alone. The workbook merges 4 calls (the service returns a different page each time) and gets downloads by exact version.
> - **Versions behind** = minor-version distance to latest. Arc releases are numbered sequentially and shipped monthly ([release notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-arc/servers/agent-release-notes)).
> - **Supported** is only an estimate: fewer than *{SupportWindow}* sequential releases behind. Policy: only agent versions released within the last year are supported. Confirm exact dates in the release notes.
> - **Auto-upgrade "On track"** = enabled, connected, with no failed last attempt, and ≤ *{AutoUpgradeTolerance}* release(s) behind latest – a heuristic: Microsoft rolls upgrades out in batches by region during off-peak hours and retries failed ones ([automatic agent upgrade](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-arc/servers/automatic-agent-upgrade)). Requirements: agent 1.67 or later; Windows PowerShell execution policy RemoteSigned; Linux cron service; Azure public cloud only. Some Microsoft Learn pages label the feature as preview – confirm its current status.
> - **Latest can lag the newest release**: it is the highest version Azure reports (auto-upgrade target and catalog API). A release already listed in the [release notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-arc/servers/agent-release-notes) may not appear there yet; use *Latest override* to force it.
> - For **Disconnected/Expired** servers the agent version is the **last reported** value.
>
> ⚠️ *Disclaimer*: auxiliary tool provided as-is; it does not replace official Microsoft compliance reporting.
> - **Security floor** (default 1.61, Edit mode): agents below it are flagged *Below security floor* independently of the support window. Basis: CVE-2026-26117 affects agents < 1.61 and CVE-2025-49692 affects agents < 1.49 (CVE records); CVE-2025-26627 and CVE-2025-55316 are listed as in *Arc Posture Review*. The two advisories checked describe the Windows agent, while the floor is applied to every operating system. The release notes list newer security fixes (for example 1.63 CVE-2026-2673 on Linux, 1.65 CVE-2026-47632) – consider raising the floor. At or above this configurable floor is NOT a security verdict; review the threshold and newly published fixes regularly.

> ℹ️ **Como a "latest" e os status são calculados (sem versões fixas no código)**
> - **Latest (por SO)** = maior valor entre: (1) o **alvo do upgrade automático definido pelo Azure** nas máquinas (`desiredVersion` / `lastAttemptDesiredVersion`), (2) a **API de catálogo do Hybrid Compute**, (3) opcionalmente o máximo da frota, ou (4) um override manual. A coluna *LatestSource* mostra qual prevaleceu.
> - A API de catálogo é **paginada**, seu conteúdo varia entre chamadas e, nos testes, não trouxe a release mais recente – por isso é usada só como comparação. O workbook combina 4 chamadas (o serviço devolve uma página diferente a cada vez) e obtém os downloads pela versão exata.
> - **Versões atrás** = distância de versão menor até a latest. As releases do Arc são numeradas em sequência e mensais ([release notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-arc/servers/agent-release-notes)).

Requisitos: agent 1.67 ou superior; Windows com execution policy RemoteSigned; Linux com serviço cron; somente nuvem pública do Azure. Algumas páginas do Microsoft Learn rotulam o recurso como preview – confirme o status atual.

Uma release já listada nas [release notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-arc/servers/agent-release-notes) pode ainda não aparecer ali; use o *Latest override* para forçá-la.

> - **Piso de segurança** (padrão 1.61, modo Edit): agents abaixo dele são marcados *Below security floor* independentemente da janela de suporte.
